description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - Industrial Disputes between National Saving Bank, Colombo 3 and other part Trade Union Front of National Saving Bank (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between National Savings Bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It constitutes a regulatory/legal matter as it formalizes labor relations, employment terms, and working conditions through statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service administration, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
